meta.title: Ponlawat Koeisuwan — Senior Full-Stack Developer
meta.description: Senior full-stack developer in Bangkok with 10+ years of experience building web products, APIs, systems and databases.

intro.statement: I turn complex requirements into reliable web products — from interface to infrastructure.

review.title: Getting approved to act on a business's social accounts
review.body: Posting, replying and reading performance on someone else's pages means passing each platform's review. I scoped access to exactly what each feature needs, documented how the data is used, and built the consent, privacy and data-deletion pieces the reviewers ask for.

steps: Request only the access each feature needs
Submit for review with use cases and policies
The business owner grants access via OAuth
Store platform tokens encrypted, revocable any time

capabilities.text: Publish posts and Reels to Pages and Instagram
Reply to messages, DMs and comments
Manage ads, campaigns and lead forms
Manage the business number and account

intro.description: For more than ten years I have worked across the whole stack — interfaces, APIs, databases and delivery pipelines. Today I bring AI into real business workflows, turning models into tools that plan, chat and sell for small businesses.

now.label: Currently building

now.diagramLabel: Platform workflow: an AI core powering content planning, image and video ads, social publishing, a multi-channel chatbot, leads and orders, and content performance analytics.

work.title: Experience, expressed through systems.
work.intro: A decade of turning complex requirements into production-ready products across finance, public services, hospitality, marketing, commerce and developer tools.

steps.label: Overview
steps.title: Listening at the speed of culture
steps.body: A real-time command center built to transform social conversation into useful intelligence.

steps.label: Challenge
steps.title: Millions of signals. One clear decision.
steps.body: The system had to make complexity legible for teams operating across markets, products and moments.

steps.label: Approach
steps.title: Designed around attention
steps.body: We reduced noise, revealed patterns and used motion to guide teams toward what mattered now.

steps.label: Solution
steps.title: A living intelligence layer
steps.body: AI classification, human judgment and responsive visual systems work together in one calm interface.

steps.label: Result
steps.title: From reaction to anticipation

services.intro: From a rough requirement to a system ready for production.
details: Responsive product interfaces built with React, Next.js, Angular, Vue.js and TypeScript.
Maintainable services and REST APIs built with Node.js, Express and NestJS.
Practical technical decisions that connect product requirements, applications and infrastructure.
Relational data models using SQL, PostgreSQL and modern ORM workflows.
Reliable delivery pipelines with GitHub Actions plus unit and end-to-end testing.

lab.intro: Small provocations, unfinished questions and new ways to make technology feel human.

about.title: I care about the whole system, not just the screen.
body: Over the past decade I have worked across frontend, backend, databases and delivery pipelines — from PHP and jQuery at an agency, through years of freelancing, to full-stack work on enterprise and public-sector platforms.

Today I build an AI-powered business platform for SMEs, where the work spans product architecture, AI workflows, social platform integrations and the reviews that make them possible. I enjoy learning, untangling difficult requirements and turning them into clear, dependable products.

principles.title: Understand the business first
principles.body: A requirement becomes a system only after I know who uses it, and why.

principles.title: Design for the next developer
principles.body: Clear modules, typed contracts and data models that stay easy to change.

principles.title: Ship continuously
principles.body: CI/CD, automated tests and small, reviewable releases over big-bang launches.

principles.title: Use AI with intent
principles.body: AI where it removes real work — with guardrails, privacy and cost in mind.

copy: A precise digital system designed to turn complexity into confident action.
The challenge was not a lack of information, but an excess of it. We reframed the experience around the decisions people actually needed to make.
Research, prototyping and motion studies ran in parallel. Each iteration tested both utility and emotional clarity.
A modular visual language brings data, narrative and interaction together without losing calm or character.
The final experience is faster to understand, easier to use and built to evolve with the organization.
